 Outside Activities
 Pursuant to subsection 15(1.1) of the Conflict of Interest Act, I will continue to practice family medicine on an occasional basis and without remuneration. This will allow me to retain my licensing, my professional qualifications, and standards of technical proficiency necessary that are necessary to maintain my ability to practice my profession once I am no longer be a reporting public office holder. Finally, the Conflict of Interest and Ethics Commissioner is of the opinion that this activity is not incompatible with my duties as a public office holder.

 Jacques Ramsay 
 · Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister of Public Safety 
 Description

— Page 2 —
Pursuant to subsection 15(1.1) of the Conflict of Interest Act, I will continue to practice family medicine on an occasional basis and without remuneration. This will allow me to retain my licensing, my professional qualifications, and standards of technical proficiency necessary that are necessary to maintain my ability to practice my profession once I am no longer be a reporting public office holder. Finally, the Conflict of Interest and Ethics Commissioner is of the opinion that this activity is not incompatible with my duties as a public office holder.
